summary: WeakRef accepts object targets and stores them weakly.

semantics.identity: deref returns exact object while live

tests.name: object target
tests.input: const x={a:1}; const r=new WeakRef(x); console.log(r.deref()===x)

tests.name: function target
tests.input: function f(){} const r=new WeakRef(f); console.log(r.deref()===f)
